description: PAID $0.002 USDC per call. Rows from one dataset listing: coingecko-markets (route id kept; ~155 Chainlink on-chain prices), defillama-protocols (our on-chain TVL), live volume-leaders, live market-heatmap, live dex-volume. Optional q keyword filter, limit (1-1000), offset, format json or csv. Returns rows from the chosen listing in json or csv, filtered and paged by the arguments.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

dataset.description: Which listing to read. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: coingecko-markets. Required. Allowed values: coingecko-markets, defillama-protocols, volume-leaders, market-heatmap, dex-volume.

format.description: Response body format. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: json. Allowed values: json, csv.

limit.description: Page size. Format: integer from 1 to 1000. Example: 100. Omit for the server's current page size.

offset.description: How many rows to skip. Format: integer, minimum 0. Example: 0. Omit to start at the first row.

q.description: Optional keyword matched against the rows. Format: plain text. Example: bitcoin. Omit for every row.

name: get_dataset
title: Dataset listing rows ($0.002)
